item.content:encoded:
Admittedly, I don't feel that CI's purpose in all this ought to be fully revealed. They thrive best in ambiguity, and no one (not even Delta Command) really knows what's their true endgame.

My personal thought would be that CI is using the time-travelling horde to break the timeline.1 They could be rewriting history (be it a past event, or something in the future). Or something else.

Little is mentioned about the Eternal Horde here, since the CI hardly controls them. As for the CI is concerned, the Eternal Horde fits the bill for whatever ambiguous objective they have for now.

Footnotes
1. Since my headcanon is that the CI push for complete chaos instead of total order.

Huh, I hadn't read Golden Horde Blues, so the only connection I could make is with the Daevites, and I was assuming a sort of Guns of the South situation.

+1, although I feel like the complete implications of what the Insurgency is trying to do, if they're based on that story, aren't entirely clear without reading it. That is, this reads like the Insurgency mucking around with a potentially extra-dimensional or supernatural GoI, rather than trying to rewrite history. The clues are there, they just didn't gell until I read the other story.

item.title: Thanks, Attribution and Other Matters
item.content:encoded:
Firstly, allow me to extend thanks to those who had seen it like sirpudding, GreenWolf, minmin and TL333s. Also thanks to Athena_Grey and vezaz, who did not roll their eyes when I threw said idea onto chat.

This article involves the following:

  • SCP-042 (The Formerly Winged Horse) ported over to this site by xthevilecorruptor and current version written by Skali Sharpnose
  • Golden Horde Blues (or at least the concept of time travelling Mongols) by vezaz
  • The Chaos Insurgency format, found here.
+ show block
– hide block

In summary, this was written to give 042 a leash in life since it feels odd for the creature to be kept in its current state for so long.

Solution: Clone it.

To make it more interesting than having the Foundation clone it, have the CI do it. And sell them to time-travelling Mongols. 'Cos that will be really random and arbitrary, which fits in thematically with a group that wishes to promote chaos in reality (contrasting with the Foundation's "order").

Not to mention that the CI format is really under-appreciated in general.
